records.observation: Icon constants RAISED/PRESSED=true, LOWERED/RELEASED=false, UP0 DOWN1 default size11. Three-argument constructor consumes direction and two booleans, snapshots UIManager colors; for boolean pair TT edges controlLtHighlight/controlDkShadow fill controlShadow; TF controlHighlight/controlShadow fill control; FT controlDkShadow/controlLtHighlight fill controlShadow; FF controlShadow/controlHighlight fill control. No enabled Component lookup and no persistent boolean state: only selected colors stored. Thus GenericHeaderRenderer released icon(1,true,raised) and pressed icon(1,false,raised) swap edge polarity; third flag selects color contrast/fill, visibility column uses true. Do not infer argument semantics solely from ambiguous constant names. Explicit Color/Color/Color/size/direction constructor stores all unchecked; width and height return size even zero/negative, unknown direction paint no-op. UI colors snapshot at construction, no automatic theme refresh or null fallback. paintIcon ignores Component including enabled status and switches DOWN/UP; neither branch saves/restores Graphics color, no own clipping/translation/background fill. Down draws top two rows, starts x+1,y+2,width=size-6, loops while row+1<y+size: two rows of left edge, positive-width fill only, right edge even if width nonpositive; x+=1,row+=2,width-=2, then bottom tip x+size/2,y+size-1 in edge1. Up starts top tip x+size/2,y, x--,row=y+1,width0, loop row+3<y+size with same paired edge/fill drawing then x--,row+=2,width+=2; lower edge finishing lines include final x..x+size at y+size-1, one pixel beyond nominal right boundary. For default11 down loop widths5,3,1,-1 (last edge segments overlap), up widths0,2,4,6; no polygon scaling or even/minimum-size validation. All coordinate arithmetic int unchecked. Down leaves graphics edge1 color, up edge2; rendering helper does not initialize Parameters/TopControl, mutate category or sort. Full static reading only, not archived GUI execution.
